title: 깊고 얇은 W2 가지와 사영의 다중 센서 확인
hypothesis: 79 found on QB (3 seeds) that C2MS_W64D16_L1S + projection beats 53 C2MS (RR +0.051 dB / -0.092 deg / -0.020) with 67% of the operations, and that without the projection it matches C2MS in RR PSNR. 80 asks whether the same recipe, unchanged, holds on GF2 (4 bands) and WV3 (8 bands) against the same-seed 54 C2MS, and how it transfers to WV2 (WV3-trained models, reference).

evidence.loss_65_other_sensors: 65 C2MS_L1S vs 54 C2MS, 3 seeds: GF2 +0.106 dB / -0.022 deg (improvement), WV3 +0.047 dB / -0.079 deg, ERGAS unchanged (partial), WV2 transfer -0.277 dB / -0.091 deg (reference)
evidence.branch_54: 54 C2MS vs 54 C0 (original), 3 seeds: improvement on GF2 and WV3
evidence.projection_66: projection was measured on QB only (about +0.04 dB per seed); GF2/WV3/WV2 projection gains are new

arms.C2MS_W64D16_L1S: 79 C2MS_W64D16_L1S unchanged (79 model.py): original SSA-MRN K4 + W2 64 channels x 16 blocks, 65 loss; 4 bands 1,641,438 parameters (used 1,523,130), 39.77 GMAC at 256x256; 8-band counts recorded by run.py optimize

projection: 79 prepare.Projected unchanged, with the Wald operator of the test sensor (WV2 operator on the WV2 transfer test); interior margin 5, CG per band in float64 (tol 1e-8, at most 400 iterations); parameter-free
loss: original per-pixel L1 + 1.0 x per-pixel L1 on 2x coarser pairs + 0.46 x spectral loss (58: mean over pixels of 1 - cos between predicted and GT band vectors, zero-norm pixels skipped) on the original pair; history fields train_mse/coarse_train_mse hold mean absolute errors
spectral_weight_note: 0.46 for every sensor, as 65 stage 3 (the QB calibration unchanged)
ema_note: the 58 trainer records EMA weights (beta 0.99) as in 65; selection uses the online weights (validation MSE), EMA weights are recorded only

transfer_tests.WV2: WV3-trained models evaluated on the WV2 test set (PanCollection convention; WV2 has no training data); reference only under v2.4

comparisons.official: per training sensor (GF2, WV3): arm + projection vs plain 54 C2MS of the same seed, 3-seed mean (criteria v2.4, RR only, threshold 0.04 dB)
comparisons.structure: arm vs 65 C2MS_L1S (same loss and data, C2MS branch), raw and projected
comparisons.reference: WV2 transfer (all comparisons, reference only); 65 + projection vs 54, 54 + projection vs 54, arm vs 54 C0 (share of the C2MS gain)

stages.run: one queue of six trainings (GF2 and WV3, seeds 42-44), two at once; every run is evaluated after the queue's trainings finish; no stage gate (the 79 recipe is unchanged)
stages.lightweight_reference: reported, not a judgement: 3-seed mean RR PSNR of the arm without projection at or above 54 C2MS - 0.04 dB counts as non-inferior
stages.automation: run.py trains, evaluates and summarizes in one controller; nothing is tuned between runs

expected_duration: about 15 h of training (two at once: GF2 about 146 s and WV3 about 95 s per epoch, scaled from 65 and 79), plus about 2 h of evaluations with the projection
limits: 3 seeds per sensor; WV2 is a transfer test and is not judged
the spectral weight 0.46 was calibrated on QB and is reused unchanged (as 65)
the projection could also be applied to C2MS itself; both comparisons are reported
precision: FP16 AMP core training with GradScaler; FP32 transforms, loss, validation and evaluation (as 53/63)
scenes_note: the fixed QB scene indices 0, 1, 3, 7, 14, 17 are reused on GF2, WV3 and WV2 (as 65 stage 3); chosen before training, not from results
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch 0, earliest exact tie; test never used for selection (same rule as 53/65)
